experience.title: Full Stack Developer
experience.description:

• Cut search p95 latency from 340ms to 90ms on discovery serving 1.8M queries/day, via index tuning and a Redis result cache, with no regression in result relevance
• Tech: Vue, React, GO, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, LLM

experience.title: Full Stack Developer

• Designed and shipped the platform's RBAC layer (9 roles, 140+ permissions, 6 services), unblocking enterprise customers that required granular access control and retiring per-customer permission workarounds
• Tech: React, Vue, Electron, Redis, Jenkins, SCSS
